rules.label: FPL 0-100%
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is at or below 100% of the FPL are eligible to receive free care.

rules.label: FPL 100-125%
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 100% and below 125% of the FPL would be eligible for up to an 80% discount.

rules.label: FPL 125-150%
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 125% and below 150% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 60% discount.

rules.label: FPL 150-200%
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 150% and below 200% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 40% discount.

rules.label: FPL 200-250%
rules.quote: Patients whose family income is over 200% and below 250% of the FPL would be eligible for up to a 20% discount.

rules.label: Case-by-case over 250% FPL
rules.quote: Patients whose family income exceeds 250% of the FPL will generally not be deemed eligible for financial assistance; but, may be considered for financial assistance on a case-by-case basis based on their specific circumstances, such as catastrophic illness or medical indigence, at the discretion of RGH.

notes: The policy excludes non-employed providers such as Rocky Mountain Radiology, Aurora Denver Cardiology, Urology Associates, North Colorado Springs Foot Clinic, San Luis Valley Health, and Dr. Matthew K. Chang from financial assistance.
Extraordinary Collection Actions (ECA) are not initiated for emergency care provided by RGH, including emergency and inpatient care and attached ancillary services.
The hospital will take measures to reverse any ECA if the account is later determined to qualify for financial assistance.
Applications may be processed at any point in the collection cycle, and need is re-evaluated every 12 months or upon financial situation change.

Presumptive eligibility may be based on circumstances such as homelessness, WIC participation, food stamp eligibility, subsidized school lunch, other unfunded state/local assistance programs, low-income/subsidized housing, or deceased patient with no known estate.
Discounted rates shall not exceed amounts generally billed to commercially insured patients.
Financial assistance is not a substitute for personal responsibility; patients are expected to cooperate and contribute based on ability to pay.
The hospital will not send unpaid bills to outside collections for patients who qualify for financial assistance and are cooperating in good faith.
If a collection agency identifies an account as meeting financial assistance eligibility, the account may be considered for assistance.
The hospital complies with Colorado DSH and Hospital Discount Care rules.
